description: Labeled natural-language and symbol-shaped search probes over the Rust polyglot calibration corpus (job queue / worker scheduling domain).

probes.query: sum the values for entries that are still outstanding, skipping over any that have already wrapped up
turn a numeric ranking into one of a few descriptive severity words
compute the unused space before a resource hits its limit, safely handling the case where it's already full
check whether two entries next to each other in a sequence both exceed some cutoff value
decide whether a new item may start given a numeric importance value and how full the pipeline currently is
find the gap between the minimum and maximum entries in a batch of numbers
